# The Algebraic Foundation: Symmetric Lie Algebras

This chapter formalizes the foundational symmetry of the Information Manifold. The theory begins with the premise that the structure of inference is constrained by an underlying involutive Lie automorphism.

## The Involutive Lie Structure

The core object of the algebraic sector is the **`SymmetricLieAlgebra`**. It consists of a Lie algebra $\mathfrak{g}$ and an involutive automorphism $	heta \in 	ext{Aut}(\mathfrak{g})$ such that $	heta^2 = 	ext{Id}$.

```lean
-- Module: InfoGeometry.Core.SymmetricLie
def ofInvolutiveLieAut (θ : InvolutiveLieAut L) :
    SymmetricLieAlgebra L := 
  { θ := ⟨θ.1, θ.2⟩
    involutive := θ.involutive }
```

## The Cartan Decomposition

The automorphism $	heta$ induces a canonical **Cartan Decomposition** of the underlying space $V$:

$$V = V^+ \oplus V^-$$

where $V^+$ is the **Even Subspace** and $V^-$ is the **Odd Subspace**.

```lean
-- File: InfoGeometry/Core/UnifiedGeometry.lean
def IsEven (C : CartanDecomposition V) (v : V) : Prop :=
  C.θ v = v

def IsOdd (C : CartanDecomposition V) (v : V) : Prop :=
  C.θ v = -v
```
